raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogical relationship by stating that to find Princess Augusta’s paternal grandmother, they needed “George II’s grandmother (the mother of George I),” conflating grandmother with great-grandmother. This led to proposing George I’s mother (Christiane Henriette) instead of the correct paternal grandmother, Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen (George II’s mother).
